purpose: Canonical, non-redundant skill library for AuraTrix/AulaFIX over AEC, Italian public administration and law, construction history 1800-present, digital tools, documents, business and media.

snapshot.source_scope: Tracked HEAD only. G16 was already present in the branch before G17 work; its files are not attributed to G17 and are not modified.
snapshot.content_boundary: The repository evidence establishes structure, paths and deterministic counts; it does not establish factual, technical, legal, educational, licensing or professional correctness.

non_redundancy_contract.primary_owner_rule: Every skill has exactly one canonical branch and one canonical skill_id. A source pack is assigned to exactly one primary branch in this artifact.
non_redundancy_contract.facet_rule: Geography, period, lifecycle, actor, artifact type and risk are facets. Facets may filter or cross-link a canonical skill but never create a second copy of it.
non_redundancy_contract.alias_rule: Aliases and historical names resolve to the canonical skill_id; they are not additional skills.
non_redundancy_contract.evidence_rule: A structural presence or a reference is not promoted to verified knowledge. Promotion requires provenance, version/date, rights, expert review and evaluation evidence.
non_redundancy_contract.source_rule: Source, interpretation, example and hypothesis remain separate fields in downstream records.

state_definitions.meaning: Path, manifest, count or deterministic report was observed in the selected checkout.
state_definitions.allowed_claim: The artifact exists in the observed snapshot.
state_definitions.not_proven: Semantic, factual, legal, didactic, licensing or real-world correctness.

state_definitions.meaning: Material is available as a reference corpus or example, but is not approved as authoritative answer knowledge.
state_definitions.next_gate: Attach provenance, jurisdiction/period, rights, review and evaluation evidence.

state_definitions.meaning: A human decision is still required for scope, mapping, provenance, semantic equivalence or coverage.
state_definitions.current_examples: Six G5 pending items, two unmatched legacy exams and 85 open G14 review clusters.

state_definitions.meaning: A release or operational gate prevents promotion or automation.
state_definitions.current_example: G7 release-readiness is BLOCKED while pending and unmatched review remains open.

state_definitions.meaning: A desired branch or subskill is not evidenced as implemented in this checkout and is roadmap work.
A future promotion state reserved for reviewed, versioned and provenance-backed knowledge.
state_definitions.warning: No current repository count promotes content to this state.

added_skill_library_branches.label: Scientific foundations, mathematics, physics and explainable calculation
added_skill_library_branches.scope: Foundational science, mathematics, physics and construction formulas kept separate from professional sign-off.

added_skill_library_branches.label: Technical documents, records, evidence and review workflows
added_skill_library_branches.scope: Technical records, surveys, estimates, reports, evidence packets, review states and controlled document lifecycle.

added_skill_library_branches.label: Construction business, real estate and operations
added_skill_library_branches.scope: Construction enterprise management, real estate, facility management, condominium, hospitality and operational delivery.
added_skill_library_branches.financial_boundary: Market, investment, tax and insurance content requires date, territory, source and professional review.

added_skill_library_branches.label: Media, marketing, visual communication and publication
added_skill_library_branches.scope: Marketing for construction companies, visual language, content operations, media assets, rights and publication controls.
added_skill_library_branches.publication_boundary: No automatic publication, endorsement or rights clearance is implied by the presence of a marketing or media reference.

coverage_invariants.primary_assignment_target: Each of the 83 non-test COURSE.yaml paths is assigned once in primary_pack_refs; this is a proposed taxonomy mapping and remains needs_review until audited.

roadmap.objective: Freeze the deterministic snapshot, canonical IDs, one-owner rule and explicit status vocabulary.
Resolve the six G5 pending items, two legacy unmatched exams and 85 G14 clusters with evidence references and human decisions.
guardrails: Do not merge, delete or rewrite corpus content from a similarity signal alone.
Keep public exam questions separate from answer keys.

roadmap.objective: Attach source, version/effective date, jurisdiction or period, rights/license and reviewer to each candidate skill record.
roadmap.promotion_rule: Only records passing source, provenance, expert review and evaluation gates may move from reference_only to verified_knowledge.

roadmap.objective: Fill missing coverage without creating parallel skills: worldwide 1800-present history grid; current Italian PA/legal versioning; controlled document templates; reproducible CAD/BIM/runtime checks; business/media rights and publication evidence.
Release only after structural, provenance, semantic, runtime and professional gates agree.
required_checks: Runtime or browser checks where applicable
Qualified human sign-off for legal, safety, financial and professional claims

non_goals: This artifact does not rewrite or deduplicate corpus files.
This artifact does not certify a law, standard, calculation, price, product, exam answer or professional document.
This artifact does not claim that all world history, Italian law, digital tools or media rights are currently covered.
This artifact does not authorize sending, payment, publication, professional filing or execution.
